# Read-only reads of the C4 for docs/research/scanout-research.md (evidence key E12), taken over SSH: cat of /proc nodes and devmem reads. No write, no app launch, no display change.
# 2026-10-29 01:11-01:12 UTC (uptime about 40,676-40,700 s), kernel 5.4.268-329.ptl4tv.2, chip O22A3. LumaTV's compositor held the DRM master (a test round; OSD0 shows its linear XR24 pages, vsync clock 120 Hz).
# The register values are what `cat /proc/lg/fbdev/regdump` printed; the decode of the fields is in scanout-research.md, section 'A second OSD layer in the hardware'. Pointer values of fbinfo/fbcon lines are left out.
